## Remove all rhodolith beds < 100m

```{r Masks > than and ≤ than 100m}
# Geopatial mask for less than or equal to 100m depth:
mask_less_than_100m<- rast(
  here("_habitats/HAB_soft_bottom/int/mask_depth_le_100m_1km.tif")
)

# Inspect mask
plot(mask_less_than_100m)
# Mask is a series of 0 and 1

# Shallow water: value 1
shallow_mask <- ifel(mask_less_than_100m == 1, 1, NA)

# Deep water: value 0
deep_mask <- ifel(mask_less_than_100m == 0, 1, NA)

# Convert the mask to polygons
shallow_poly <- as.polygons(
  shallow_mask,
  dissolve = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

deep_poly <- as.polygons(
  deep_mask,
  dissolve = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

plot(shallow_poly)
plot(deep_poly)
```

```{r Keep rhodolith beds within the ≤ 100 m mask}
pts <- terra::vect(CEDO_rhodolith.data_raw)

shallow_poly <- project(shallow_poly, crs(pts))
deep_poly <- project(deep_poly, crs(pts))

shallow_hit <- relate(
  pts, shallow_poly,
  relation = "intersects"
)

deep_hit <- relate(
  pts, deep_poly,
  relation = "intersects"
)

is_shallow <- apply(shallow_hit, 1, any)
is_deep <- apply(deep_hit, 1, any)

# FILTER:
colnames(CEDO_rhodolith.data_raw)

FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area <- CEDO_rhodolith.data_raw %>%
  filter(is_shallow & !is_deep) %>%
  mutate(
    provenance = coalesce(
      na_if(trimws(REFEREN), ""),
      na_if(trimws(source), "")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    habitat, source = provenance, area_ha,
    lat = LATITUD, lon = LONGITU, geometry
  )
# 102 obs., 6 var.

plot(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area)
```


```{r Check that lat long and area values align with polygon values we would expect}
# Check that the polygon CRS is defined
st_crs(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area)

# Create point geometries from lon/lat
points_sf <- st_as_sf(
  FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area,
  coords = c("lon", "lat"),
  crs = st_crs(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area),
  remove = FALSE
)

# Transform points into the polygon CRS
points_projected <- st_transform(
  points_sf,
  st_crs(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area)
)

# Test whether each point falls inside its corresponding polygon
FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area <- FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area %>%
  mutate(
    point_inside = lengths(
      st_covered_by(
        points_projected,
        geometry,
        sparse = TRUE
      )
    ) > 0
  )

# Inspect the results
FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(habitat, lat, lon, point_inside)

table(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area$point_inside)
# 102 true. Looks good!

# Check polygon area versus reported area:

FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area <- FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area %>%
  mutate(
    polygon_area_ha = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 10000,
    area_difference_ha = polygon_area_ha - area_ha,
    percent_difference = 100 * area_difference_ha / area_ha
  ) %>%
  select(
    habitat, source, reported_area_ha = area_ha, polygon_area_ha,
    area_difference_ha, percent_difference,
    lat, lon, geometry
  )
# 102 obs.

```

```{r Assign RHOD extent to each OHI region}
# Assign each Rhodolith polygon to an OHI region (this will drop any land overlap, if applicable):
RHOD_Current_Extent0 <- st_intersection(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area, ohi_marine) %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  mutate(
    poly_id   = dplyr::row_number(),
    region_id = as.integer(id),
    area_ha = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 10000, 
    area_km2  = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6 # NOTE: st_area default unit is m2
  ) %>%
  filter(area_km2 > 0) %>%
  select(habitat, source, area_ha, area_km2, rgn_id, ecorgn, lat, lon, geometry)

RHOD_Current_Extent0

colnames(RHOD_Current_Extent0)

RHOD_Current_Extent <- RHOD_Current_Extent0 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    area_ha = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    area_km2 = sum(area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    year = 2025
  )

all_rgns <- tibble(

)

RHOD_Current_Extent <- all_rgns %>%
  left_join(RHOD_Current_Extent, by = c("rgn_id", "year")) %>%
  mutate(area_km2 = replace_na(area_km2, 0)) %>%

         area_est_byCEDO.2025_km2 = area_km2, 
         year)
```

# STEP 3: CALCULATE RHODOLITH "CURRENT STATUS", i.e. condition over time (source: fishing pressure data derived from Villaseñor VMS data, 2007-2025)  ------------------------------

## VMS Fishing Pressure Data (1991-2021)

```{r Read in fishing pressure data}
VMS_fishing_pressure <- rast(

)

```

```{r Keep fishing pressure within the <100 m mask}
deep_poly   <- project(deep_poly, crs(VMS_fishing_pressure))

# Rasterize polygons onto the raster grid
```

## Extract soft-bottom pressure under rhodolith beds

```{r Extract soft-bottom pressure underneath rhodolith beds}
# Restore original layer names
names(VMS_fishing_pressure_le100m) <- original_names

pressure_raster <- VMS_fishing_pressure_le100m
# Check CRS:
crs(pressure_raster)

# Convert rhodolith polygons to a SpatVector
rhodolith_vect <- terra::vect(RHOD_Current_Extent0)
# Check CRS:
crs(rhodolith_vect)

# Extract area-weighted mean fishing pressure value for each rhodolith polygon
# Note, some rhodolith polygons encompase multiple VMS raster cells, so we need to take the area-weighted mean:
pressure_values <- terra::extract(
  pressure_raster,
  rhodolith_vect,
  fun = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  weights = TRUE, # This line assigning area weights is critical
  ID = TRUE
)

# Join extracted values back to the original polygon data
RHOD_Current_Status00 <- RHOD_Current_Extent0 %>%
  mutate(ID = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(pressure_values, by = "ID") %>%
  select(-ID)

# Prop = average predicted probability of fishing disturbance per rhodolith bed x year.
# Example, if prop = 0.7, this means an average predicted disturbance probability of 70% across the extracted cells.
```


Pressure under each bed = area-weighted mean of `VMS_fishing_pressure` cells overlapping the polygon.
No recovery scaling applied for now (same 0–1 exposure scale as soft bottom).

```{r Calculate RHOD_Current_Status0}

# Identify annual pressure columns
pressure_cols <- grep(
  "^prop_disturbed_\\d{4}$",
  names(RHOD_Current_Status00),
  value = TRUE
)

 # Convert data from wide to long format
RHOD_Current_Status0 <- RHOD_Current_Status00 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(pressure_cols),
    names_to = "layer",
    values_to = "prop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(sub("prop_disturbed_", "", layer))
  )
 
# Calculate area-weighted average pressure per region × year
RHOD_Current_Status0 <- RHOD_Current_Status0 %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(prop),
    !is.na(rgn_id),
    !is.na(area_km2),
    area_km2 > 0
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(rgn_id, year) %>%
  summarise(
    area_sum_km2 = sum(area_km2),
    Pressure = sum(prop * area_km2) / area_sum_km2,
    Condition = 1 - Pressure,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pressure = Pressure * 100,
    Condition = Condition * 100
  )

RHOD_Current_Status0

```

```{r Compare observed cover post- and pre- HISTORIC_CUTOFF}

# Fill in regions that are missing (i.e., do not have rhodolith beds):
RHOD_Current_Status0 <- RHOD_Current_Status0 %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    rgn_id = paste0("Region_", 1:9),
    year = RHOD_HISTORIC_START:RHOD_CONTEMPORARY_END
  )
# 171 obs., 5 vars.

# DECISION POINT: Historic cut off = pre and post 2015
HISTORIC_CUTOFF = RHOD_HISTORIC_END

# Distinguish between pre- and post- historic baseline
RHOD_Current_Status <- RHOD_Current_Status0 %>%
  mutate(
    period = if_else(year < RHOD_HISTORIC_END, "historic", "contemporary")
  )

RHOD_Current_Status <- RHOD_Current_Status %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  mutate(
    historic_mean = mean(
      Condition[year < HISTORIC_CUTOFF],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    contemporary_mean = mean(
      Condition[year >= HISTORIC_CUTOFF],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    # Calculate current status in CONTEMPORARY vs. HISTORIC
    RHOD_current_status = case_when(

      # No historic or contemporary rhodolith observations
      is.nan(historic_mean) & is.nan(contemporary_mean) ~ NA_real_,

      # Historic period
      year < HISTORIC_CUTOFF & is.finite(historic_mean) ~ 100,

      # Contemporary period: calculate relative to historic baseline
      year >= HISTORIC_CUTOFF &
        is.finite(historic_mean) &
        historic_mean > 0 &
        is.finite(contemporary_mean) ~
        pmax(0, pmin((contemporary_mean / historic_mean) * 100, 100)),

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Pressure = round(Pressure, 2),
    Condition = round(Condition, 2),
    RHOD_current_status = round(RHOD_current_status, 2),
    historic_mean = round(historic_mean, 2),
    contemporary_mean = round(contemporary_mean, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    rgn_id, year, period,
    area_est_byCEDO.2025_km2= area_sum_km2,
    Pressure, Opposite_Pressure= Condition, 
    historic_mean, contemporary_mean, RHOD_current_status
  )

# Relevel:
RHOD_Current_Status <- RHOD_Current_Status %>%
  mutate(
    period = factor(
      period,
      levels = c("historic", "contemporary")
    )
  )
# 171 obs., 9 vars.

```

```{r Plot opposite_pressure on rhodoliths over time}

historic_mean <- unique(RHOD_Current_Status$historic_mean)
contemporary_mean <- unique(RHOD_Current_Status$contemporary_mean)

periods <- RHOD_Current_Status %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    historic_mean = first(historic_mean),
    contemporary_mean = first(contemporary_mean),
    pre_start = min(year[year < HISTORIC_CUTOFF]),
    post_end = max(year[year >= HISTORIC_CUTOFF]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot:
RHOD_Opp.Pressure_OverTime<- RHOD_Current_Status %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(year, Opposite_Pressure, color = period)) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~rgn_id) +
  
  # Period means
  geom_segment(
    data = periods,
    aes(x = pre_start, xend = HISTORIC_CUTOFF, 
        y = historic_mean, yend = historic_mean),
    color = "blue", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = periods,
    aes(x = HISTORIC_CUTOFF, xend = post_end, 
        y = contemporary_mean, yend = contemporary_mean),
    color = "orange", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = HISTORIC_CUTOFF,
    color = "gray40",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("historic" = "blue", "contemporary" = "orange")
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Historic versus Contemporary Opposite_Pressure on Rhodolith Beds",
    subtitle = "Opposite_Pressure estimates estimated using fisheries VMS trawl data",
    caption = "updated: Nov 10 2026",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Opposite_Pressure (0-100)",
    color = "Period"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r Calculate RHOD_Trend using METHOD A modified}
colnames(RHOD_Current_Status)

# Historic midpoint: first and last observed years, 1998–2009
historic_years <- RHOD_Current_Status %>%
  filter(
    year < HISTORIC_CUTOFF
  ) %>%
  group_by(rgn_name, rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    historic_midpoint = (min(year) + max(year)) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Contemporary midpoint: first and last observed years, 2010 onward
contemporary_years <- RHOD_Current_Status %>%
  filter(
    year >= HISTORIC_CUTOFF
  ) %>%
  group_by(rgn_name, rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    contemporary_midpoint = (min(year) + max(year)) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Retrieve existing means and calculate trend
RHOD_Trend0 <- RHOD_Current_Status %>%
  group_by(rgn_name, rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    RHOD_include_exclude = first(RHOD_include_exclude),
    historic_condition = first(historic_mean),
    contemporary_condition = first(contemporary_mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(historic_years, by = c("rgn_name", "rgn_id")) %>%
  inner_join(contemporary_years, by = c("rgn_name", "rgn_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    n_years = contemporary_midpoint - historic_midpoint,
    trend = (contemporary_condition - historic_condition) / n_years,
    trend_method = "Modified Method A: contemporary midpoint vs. historic midpoint"
  ) %>%
  select(
    rgn_name, rgn_id, RHOD_include_exclude,
    historic_midpoint, contemporary_midpoint, n_years,
    historic_condition, contemporary_condition,
    trend, trend_method
  )

RHOD_Trend0
# 9 obs., 10 vars.

```

```{r Clean before saving}
RHOD_Trend <- RHOD_Trend0 %>%
  arrange(as.integer(sub("Region_", "", rgn_id))) %>%
  mutate(
    year = 2025
  ) %>%
  relocate(year, .after = RHOD_include_exclude)
# 9 obs., 11 vars.
```

```{r Save RHOD_Trend}
          file= "/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/_habitats/HAB_rhodolith_beds/RHO_outputs/RHOD_Trend_1.1_Nov102026.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
# 9 obs., 11 vars.
```
